title: Tom's Free Time
text:
Tom likes to spend his free time outdoors. On Saturdays, he goes to the park with his dog, Max. They play with a ball and run around the big trees. Tom says the park makes him happy.

On Sunday, Tom likes to read books at home. He reads about animals and space. Sometimes his sister, Anna, reads with him. They love their quiet afternoons together.

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom most likely to be?
options: A person who likes calm activities
A person who never leaves home

vocabulary.definition: in the open air, not inside a building
things you read, with many pages
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Tom boş zamanını açık havada geçirmeyi sever. Cumartesi günleri köpeği Max ile parka gider. Bir topla oynarlar ve büyük ağaçların etrafında koşarlar. Tom'a göre park onu mutlu eder.
Pazar günü Tom evde kitap okumayı sever. Hayvanlar ve uzay hakkında okur. Bazen kız kardeşi Anna onunla birlikte okur. İkisi sessiz öğleden sonraları birlikte geçirmeyi çok severler.
